user.title: BRMesh via Home Assistant Bluetooth
user.description: Commands are broadcast from this Bluetooth adapter. Use the phone key from the BRMesh app if your lights are already set up there.

error.invalid_key: Must be exactly 8 hex characters, e.g. A1A2A3A4.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a BRMesh light.
abort.bluez_unavailable: Could not reach BlueZ over D-Bus. This option needs Home Assistant running on Linux (Home Assistant OS, Supervised, or Docker with /run/dbus mounted).
abort.no_adapters: No local Bluetooth adapter that can advertise was found. Bluetooth proxies can't send commands.

data_description.advertise_duration: How long each command is broadcast. Shorter is faster; raise it if lights miss commands.

add_device.title: Add a light manually
add_device.description: Use the values from a discovery log or an ESPHome fastcon light.

error.invalid_device_type: Must be exactly 4 hex characters, e.g. A8A1.

abort.not_loaded: The integration must be loaded to add lights.
